title: Archetyping contribution value
description: Value type for contributions on the Archetyping panel. Asserts: 'this archetype URI applies to the referenced SubjectIdentity.' Each ArchetypingKS contribution proposes ONE archetype URI; the resolved set across all contributions for a SubjectIdentity is the effective archetypeRefs.

archetypeRef.description: Versioned gsmarc:// Archetype URI. The base GSM primitive Archetype URI for the SubjectIdentity.subjectKind MUST be contributed (by an engine-shipped IdentificationKS or by a domain ArchetypingKS); resolved Archetyping for an identity is invalid without it.

appliesUnder.description: Optional: structural conditions the contributor checked (e.g. annotation present, file location pattern). Captured for audit; not interpreted by the engine.
